sql:
SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY a.element
